# Light Efficient Design: full product digest

> Plain-text edition of led-llc.com, generated from the same catalog data as the site on 2026-10-12. Values are as printed in the 2026 Full Product Catalog; the spec sheet is the final reference.

Sales: 847.380.3540, sales@led-llc.com. Corporate HQ & Training Center: 188 S. Northwest Highway, Cary, IL 60013. Innovation & Manufacturing Center: 30 Log Bridge Road, Building 200, Middleton, MA 01949.

# Light Efficient Design

Retrofit lamps that turn any HID or fluorescent fixture into LED. Screw-in and pin-base LED retrofits for the fixtures already on the job, plus temporary work lights. Keep the fixture, swap the lamp, cut the energy.

Page: https://www.led-llc.com/light-efficient-design.html

- Keep the fixture: Ballast-bypass and ballast-compatible lamps fit the sockets you already have.
- FlexWatt + FlexColor: Pick wattage and color temperature on the lamp, so one SKU covers many jobs.
- 5-year warranty: Long rated life and surge protection built for parking lots, high bays and hazardous areas.

## Bollard + Post Top (Light Efficient Design › Screw-In Retrofits)

Page: https://www.led-llc.com/bollard-post-top.html · Catalog p. 2–4

Replaces up to 1000W HID.

Keep the look and feel of your existing fixture, while saving energy and maintenance costs. Several models feature FlexWatt and FlexColor allowing for substantial sku reduction and in-field adjustability.

Highlights:
- ('LED-8000 — multiple voltage options & longer neck for a better fit.', 3).
- ('Smaller because size does matter.', 3).
- ('Frosted lens', 3).
- ('Available in 2200K, 4000K & 5000K.', 3).

Features:
- 5-year warranty
- UL Type B ballast bypass
- Active cooling
- 80+ CRI
- Enclosed fixtures
- Operating temp -40°F to 113°F (8029 / 8024 / 8027 / 8028)
- Operating temp -40°F to 122°F (8037 / 8038 / 8039 / 8000 / 8075)
- Damp location environment
- L70 50,000hrs rated life
- Frosted lens (801X and 802X models (LED-8017E345-G3 to LED-8021M345-G3))
- HV = 277-480V including 347V
- MV = 208-347V
- DLC (For listing status go to LED-LLC.com)

### Size comparison

Smaller because size does matter. Each triplet shows the HID lamp being replaced, our retrofit and a typical competitor LED corn lamp of the same wattage class; overall lengths are marked for the HID lamp and the competitor.

Footnotes:
- 120-277V also works on 208V & 240V
- * Excludes 8037-39 models (applies to the Active Cooling feature)
- DLC: for listing status go to LED-LLC.com

Case study: Pic Quik, Las Cruces, NM: Top-to-bottom store retrofit (https://www.led-llc.com/docs/Pic-Quik-Case-Study.pdf). HID gas canopy fixtures were wasting energy and caused a maintenance headache, with bulbs and ballasts constantly being replaced. The gas canopy fixtures were easily retrofitted with the directional, horizontal-mount LED-8090. Ease of install and superior light output immediately led to retrofitting the entire store. A brighter, more efficient retail environment that is safer and easier to shop, all while standing out amongst the competition.

## Shoe Box + Wall Pack (Light Efficient Design › Screw-In Retrofits)

Page: https://www.led-llc.com/shoe-box-wall-pack.html · Catalog p. 6–7

Replaces up to 400W HID.

Retrofit almost any shoe box or wall pack fixture to energy & maintenance saving LEDs. Eliminate ballast failures. FlexColor on several models allows for less stocked inventory as well as field adjustability.

Highlights:
- ('Rotatable base directs lumens out of fixture.', 12).

Features:
- 5-year warranty
- UL Type B ballast bypass
- Active cooling
- 80+ CRI
- Enclosed fixtures
- -40°F to 122°F operating temp
- Damp location environment
- L70 50,000 hrs rated life
- FlexColor selectable CCT 3000K/4000K/5000K (All models; factory default 4000K)
- Rotatable base directs lumens out of fixture
- 277-480V incl. 347V (HV) (LED-8090M345D-G4-HV only)
- DLC (For listing status go to LED-LLC.com)

### Models and downloads

- Note: FlexColor (-FC) models switch between 3000K, 4000K and 5000K on the lamp, with 4000K as the factory default.
- Note: 120-277V models also work on 208V and 240V. -HV models run on 277-480V (can be used on 347V).
- Note: CRI 80+ (LED-8091: 70+). LED-8091 3000K is a special order, minimum order 100 pieces.

### Size comparison

Our compact shoe box retrofits next to the HID lamps they replace and typical LED corn lamps of the same wattage: ED17 HID vs LED-8087E (ours, 30W) vs a 30W corn lamp; ED37 HID vs LED-8090M (ours, 110W) vs a 110W corn lamp.

Video: LED Shoe Box / Wall Pack Retrofits (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ypXSpfRoVVA). See how Light Efficient Design LED retrofit lamps turn existing shoe box and wall pack fixtures into efficient LED lighting.

Case study: Pic Quik, Las Cruces, NM: Top-to-bottom store retrofit (https://www.led-llc.com/docs/Pic-Quik-Case-Study.pdf). HID gas canopy fixtures were wasting energy and caused a maintenance headache, with bulbs and ballasts constantly being replaced. The gas canopy fixtures were easily retrofitted with the directional, horizontal-mount LED-8090. Ease of install and superior light output immediately led to retrofitting the entire store. A brighter, more efficient retail environment that is safer and easier to shop, all while standing out amongst the competition.

## High Bay + Low Bay (Light Efficient Design › Screw-In Retrofits)

Page: https://www.led-llc.com/high-bay-low-bay.html · Catalog p. 8–9

Replaces up to 1000W HID.

Ultra-bright LED retrofits for high ceiling environments. Models without active cooling for open fixtures & silent operation. Models with active cooling are safe to install in enclosed fixtures. Low bay retrofits are ideal for ceiling fixtures that require light to be pushed down and out. Angled LED panels help direct light exactly where it is needed.

Highlights:
- ('Powerful performance – for high bay environments.', 6).

### Beam angle by model

### 90° rotatable head

The 7316 / 7318 / 7328 lamps have a head that rotates 90° and a base that can be extended by up to 1.0 in

Case study: Pic Quik, Las Cruces, NM: Top-to-bottom store retrofit (https://www.led-llc.com/docs/Pic-Quik-Case-Study.pdf). HID gas canopy fixtures were wasting energy and caused a maintenance headache, with bulbs and ballasts constantly being replaced. The gas canopy fixtures were easily retrofitted with the directional, horizontal-mount LED-8090. Ease of install and superior light output immediately led to retrofitting the entire store. A brighter, more efficient retail environment that is safer and easier to shop, all while standing out amongst the competition.

# RemPhos

Fixtures, retrofit kits and linkable light bars engineered to install fast. Innovatively engineered LED fixtures and retrofits that make installation as fast and easy as possible, with controls and color that maximize the lighting experience for end users.

Page: https://www.led-llc.com/remphos.html

- 1. Innovatively engineered: LED fixtures and retrofits making installation as fast and easy as possible.
- 2. Controllable and customizable: Fixtures and retrofits that maximize the lighting experience for end users.
- 3. The name: Derived from the remote layer of phosphor that converts blue LED light to white.

- Commercial real estate: On your schedule. Zero energy costs, maximum visibility, no utility connections and no disruptive construction.

### How to read a pole part number

SL-RSP = round straight pole, SL-RPSQ = square straight pole; the following segments are mounting height in feet, shaft diameter in inches and wall thickness gauge (11 or 7); AB = anchor base, EMB = direct burial (embedded); XX = mounting option (T2 / T2.5 / T3 tenon); YY = finish color (BK / DB / GR). Example: SL-RSP-20-4-11-AB-T2-DB.

Footnotes:
- Anchor base poles: XX = mounting option, T2 = 2 3/8 in tenon, T2.5 = 2 7/8 in tenon, T3 = 3 in tenon
- Direct burial poles: XX = mounting option, T2 = 2 3/8 in tenon, T2.5 = 2 7/8 in tenon (no T3 option for direct-burial poles)
- YY = finish color: BK = Black, DB = Dark Bronze, GR = Gray
- Max EPA headings (80), (90), (100) and (120) are wind speeds in mph
